messages.author: 37d8c5be0a76cd3d
messages.subject: Aligning scales across viewports
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to produce a layout made up of viewports stacked above one another. It's really important that the x axes for the graphs in each viewports are exactly aligned with each other. I have been using the following code which is close but the axes are still slightly different lengths. I would really appreciate any help you could give me to get the axes to be identical between viewports if this is possible.

I have tried to find a solution for this with Google but have been unsuccessful so far. However, I am pretty new to ggplot so I'm sorry if I've missed something obvious.

Thanks a lot,

Mike

The code is as follows:

mappable_reads_plot <- ggplot() + geom_rect(data=mappable_reads,aes(xmin=Start,xmax=End,ymin=0,ymax=20,fill=Sense,colour=Sense)) + facet_wrap(~ read_length, ncol = 1) + scale_fill_manual(values=sense_colours) + scale_colour_manual(values=sense_colours) + opts(legend.position="none") +xlim=c(0,2608655) 
quartz(width=11.69,height=8.27)
map_plot_view <- viewport(x=unit(0,"npc"),y=unit(0,"npc"),just=c("left","bottom"),height=unit(0.5,"npc"),width=unit(1,"npc"))
pushViewport(map_plot_view)
print(mappable_reads_plot,newpage=FALSE)
upViewport()

annotations_view <- viewport(x=unit(0,"npc"),y=unit(0.5,"npc"),just=c("left","bottom"),height=unit(0.02,"npc"),width=unit(1,"npc"))
pushViewport(annotations_view)
annotations_plot <- ggplot() + geom_rect(data=newAnnotations,aes(xmin=Start,xmax=End,ymin=0,ymax=20,fill=Label,colour=Label)) + scale_fill_manual(values=labelColours) + scale_colour_manual(values=labelColours) + opts(legend.position="none") + xlim=c(0,2608655)
print(annotations_plot,newpage=FALSE)
upViewport()

messages.subject: Re: Aligning scales across viewports
parts:
Take a look at http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGally/index.html
It may have what you need. The survival curves in that package align
a table so table data columns align with the x-axis.

HTH,
Chris

messages.author: 37d8c5be0a76cd3d
messages.subject: Re: Aligning scales across viewports
parts:
Hi Chris,

Thanks a lot for that, I'll have a look at that package.

I managed to solve my problem by not using faceting to draw multiple
plots and, instead, using different viewports to draw everything
making sure that the x scale was always the same.

Thanks for the help,

Mike
